items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Urbie' only in a note, and the interviewee's spoken response discusses Irvie Green and Godfrey without mentioning Urbie or any interaction with them.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. There was plenty. There was

Irvie Green, and there was -- well, all of the big timers usually did a stint there one time or another. And, oh yes, Godfrey -- we also did the Godfrey show. Oh, many, many, many shows over a period of four years. And all of the big movie stars would do a guest appearances. You got to see everything, and experience a stint of doing a turn with all these big performers.
